وَأَبْعَدَهُ،: And he sent him away farther,
وَسَلَّمَ: And he sent greetings of peace (salutations).
الْمُحْتَسِبِ،: The one who claims or demands rights (al-muhtasib)
وَوَجِيهٌ،: And he is a man of rank,
وَنَضَّرَ: And He has made it grow
بُعِثَ: He was sent as a Messenger.
وَرُوِّينَاهُ: And We caused them to drink
وَبِسَنَدِ: And with a chain of transmission,
وَبِسَنَدِهِ: And with his chain of transmission,
الْمُلَحِيُّ،: The one who litters or fouls public places
اللَّبَّانُ،: The gum of the mastic tree,
تُحَطُّ: It is removed or taken off.
بِنَحْوِهِ،: In a manner similar to his.
يُطَوَّقُهُ: He is encircled by a collar or noose.
أَظْلِمُهَا: I will make it dark for them
النَّضْرِ: The gharība (strange), or the nadr (rare) hadith
الْمُهَلّبِ: The one who softens or makes something smooth
وَأَضْخَمَهُمْ: And He has made them grow in size
وَيُرْخِيهَا: And He will make it easy for them
خَالَطَ: He associated with or mixed with
